sentences.en: I don't want a bloody voucher. Just give me cash!
sentences.zh: 我不要什么该死的代金券。直接给我现金！

sentences.en: Sami was given a taxi voucher to call a taxi.
sentences.zh: 萨米得到了一个叫出租车的凭证。

sentences.en: The voucher the customer was given was worth ten euros.
sentences.zh: 顾客得到的那个凭证价值十欧元。

senses.zh: 收据；证人；保证人；证明者；代金
